profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Technical Lead | .NET, Azure, Distributed Systems & AI Engineering Tools
profile.summary: Senior software engineer and technical lead with 12+ years of experience designing and delivering secure, production-scale systems across C#, .NET, SQL Server, APIs, distributed services, and Azure. Hands-on technical leader with experience owning systems from architecture and implementation through deployment and production support, including payment platforms, identity systems, cloud services, and high-volume data processing. Experienced leading solution design, code review, testing strategy, technical documentation, and mentoring in customer-facing and regulated environments.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Set technical direction and delivered hands-on implementation for customer-facing applications and platform capabilities across C#, .NET, SQL Server, Next.js, Azure, and cloud infrastructure.
- Led engineering work on royalty statement and artist payment platform capabilities, supporting high-volume monthly processing, payment workflows, production operations, and payouts through the Trolley payments API.
- Implemented a scalable on-demand audio validation and encoding workflow using blob storage, backend worker services, and SignalR notifications, enabling customers to receive near real-time upload acceptance feedback without waiting for manual inspection.
- Built and maintained cloud applications and deployment infrastructure using Azure, Azure DevOps, .NET, EF Core, and SQL, supporting reliable releases and timely production troubleshooting.
- Led code review, solution design, architecture documentation, and engineering quality practices focused on security, maintainability, performance, usability, and operational reliability.
- Orchestrated AI-assisted engineering workflows for architecture exploration, code review, defect investigation, and performance optimization, validating recommendations through hands-on analysis, peer review, and automated testing before production use.
positions.insights: Leading Development Teams and Technology Leadership

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained the Soundrop cloud platform using C#, ASP.NET, JavaScript, SQL Server, JSON/XML data contracts, Azure DevOps, and PowerShell to support music distribution for independent artists.
- Refactored and ported a legacy Python statement-processing engine to C#, reducing the monthly statement run from approximately 12 hours to 5–6 hours through parallel processing and SQL query optimization.
- Implemented DDEX and XML-based integrations for exchanging and managing digital music distribution data with services including Amazon, Pandora, Deezer, Spotify, and other digital music partners.
- Designed and built a MEF-based catalog migration framework that migrated approximately 300,000 third-party releases into Soundrop, supporting provider-specific extensions for releases, tracks, cover art, audio files, and artist metadata.
- Supported application troubleshooting, release coordination, and production issue resolution across database-backed services and customer-facing workflows.
- Trained and guided junior developers on implementation practices, platform behavior, release expectations, and support workflows.

positions.title: Advanced Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed, developed, and supported secure enterprise e-discovery applications using C#, ASP.NET, SignalR, JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap, SQL Server, Azure, and PowerShell.
- Partnered with product management in a Scrum environment to refine user stories, decompose requirements, estimate effort, and improve application workflows and usability.
- Partnered with DevOps to provision Azure resource groups, virtual networks, and network security groups through PowerShell, enabling deployment, upgrades, and ongoing maintenance of Aspera Server for the Relativity File Transfer application.
- Implemented SQL Server stored procedures, operational reports, and job-queue tables using UPDLOCK, ROWLOCK, and READPAST to coordinate concurrent file-transfer processing safely and efficiently.
- Partnered with Customer Service to investigate post-release issues, connect customer impact to technical root cause, and deliver timely remediation.

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
- Developed C# automated tests for the Relativity Invariant RCC plug-in to detect breaking changes introduced by the Relativity Processing application.
- Designed and implemented an integration-test framework for Windows applications using dynamically generated code to expand repeatable test coverage.
- Built Selenium UI automation in C#, enabling on-demand regression execution and improved release confidence.
- Created automated test scenarios to validate application behavior across configuration changes, environmental differences, and failure conditions.
- Supported virtualized test environments in vSphere and VMware Workstation for repeatable testing across application configurations.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Developed a C#/.NET WPF GUI for Intel ITP-XDP, supporting hardware testing and validation workflows for Intel platform technologies.
- Supported and enhanced Intel Silicon View Technology (SVT), refactoring legacy SATA components to add support for IDE, AHCI, and RAID modes and expand platform-testing capabilities.
- Designed and implemented a reusable UI framework to provide consistent application behavior and presentation across SVT release packages.
- Performed hardware-level validation that identified a PCB/GPIO design defect.

positions.title: Computer Lab Assistant
positions.description:
I worked as an assistant for Portland Community College - Sylvania campus CRC lab and performed the following tasks: 
- Provide technical support related to computer and networking for students.
- Maintain computer system, installing operating system.
- Provide computer tutoring for students.

educations.degreeName: Transferred to Oregon Institute of Technology

projects.title: Automated Trading Platform
projects.description:
- Designed and implemented a C#/.NET trading automation system with scheduled orchestration, strategy evaluation, reconciliation workflows, risk-management concepts, and database-backed operational state.
- Built a broker plug-in system using .NET AssemblyLoadContext to support plug-and-play broker integrations such as Alpaca and Kraken without tightly coupling the core trading engine to a specific provider.
- Applied service boundaries, configuration-driven behavior, message-oriented workflow patterns, automated testing, and maintainable architecture practices to a complex automation domain.
- Built supporting workflows for market data processing, trade analysis, job scheduling, reconciliation, and operational monitoring.

projects.title: AI Personal Assistant Platform
projects.description:
- Built an AI personal assistant platform on OpenClaw with durable file-backed memory, active context tracking, Discord integration, and local retrieval services for long-running continuity across conversations and development work.
- Implemented memory retrieval and repository knowledge services using local APIs, structured indexing, hybrid search patterns, and source-linked context to improve AI-assisted engineering workflows.
- Designed privacy-aware context handling, background summarization workflows, and channel-specific memory boundaries to separate private, project, and public-facing information.
